Body_Template: Thank you for your submission. The prototype assessment found that the mandatory business, identity, authority, system, financial, and final-verification checks were completed successfully. Your request is eligible to proceed to the next operational step. This prototype has not updated any production system.
Internal_Only_Fields_Excluded: Risk scores; internal thresholds; linked-record details

Thank you for your submission. The prototype assessment identified information that requires review by an operations specialist. No final adverse decision has been made. We will review the evidence and contact you if further information is required.
